scope: Phase V4-D2 feasibility audit of the six blind proposals at research/control/stocks_free_v4_run/proposals/{a4_h1,a4_h2,a5_h1,a5_h2,a6_h1,a6_h2}.json against the frozen authorities p2_a3_data_manifest.json, p2_a3_benchmark_contract.json and baseline_invariants.json
mode: AUDIT ONLY, NO PnL: price files loaded read-only from the hash-pinned snapshot for schedule counting and coverage/field-presence arithmetic exclusively; no return computation, no signal computation, no backtest; proposal files untouched

measured_calendar_facts.manifest_crosscheck: both figures reproduce the frozen census exactly (1842 / 2076); 0 duplicate SPY dates
measured_calendar_facts.inter_fold_gaps: 5 sessions 2020-09-02..2020-09-09 region and 5 sessions 2023-02-10..2023-02-16 region; plus a 5-session unscored tail strip 2025-07-27..2025-07-31 between fold 3 end and the S0 boundary (2025-07-31); consistent with the manifest fold_consistency note (scored_end max 2025-07-24)

decision_counts_by_clock.note: no 42-grid or 63-grid tick falls inside the inter-fold gaps, so fold membership of decision sessions is unambiguous under the S0-anchored reading; k21 tick DATES differ between the two anchorings even though counts coincide (each fold is exactly 609 = 29x21 sessions)

field_presence_checks_read_only.C_equals_O_rows_present: 16..90 per symbol (mathematically fine for GK: the ln(C/O) term contributes 0, not undefined)

common_findings: PIT data: every declared input of all six proposals is within the authorized field universe (daily OHLCV raw + adjusted, 12 cohort symbols); none touches a manifest unavailable_field class (fundamentals, earnings, borrow, short interest, holdings, flows, options, intraday).

Warmup: declared warmups are 126 (A4-H1), 252 (A4-H2, A5-H1, A5-H2, A6-H1, A6-H2), all <= 252 and <= 2076/252 ~ 8.2x covered by the pre-S0 runway; each first S0 session 2018-04-04 is a valid PIT decision tick from runway data. XLC long-warmup edges are handled by declared deterministic availability rules in all six (exact dates measured above).

Benchmark/factor: all six incremental-alpha tests need only SPY_TOTAL_RETURN (SPY_all adjusted closes) and the optional EW_SECTOR_TOTAL_RETURN (11 sector _all adjusted closes) - both authorized by the frozen benchmark contract. No proposal needs an unauthorized or undefined series.

Control and drop-one: all six controls (level-sort x2, stale-rank, price-only quietness, alphabetical-ticker, close-to-close variance) and both drop-one modes (max-contribution ETF rerun, fold removal min) are constructible from the frozen conventions without new data or new authority.
Engineer-days 2.5-4.0 per proposal are sane for a V4-I lane (loader + book executor + control/neighbour variants + accounting tests, all reusing the frozen V4 accounting skeleton).

Fold arithmetic: each fold is exactly 609 SPY sessions, so floor satisfaction is identical under either clock anchoring wherever counts coincide; the A4 k21 and A6 k42 clock anchoring should nevertheless be frozen byte-exactly by the V4-I lane (see per-hypothesis notes).

blocking_conditions: C1 (must freeze before any scored computation): kappa_t = clip(OLS slope of arm spread returns on SPY TR over trailing 252 sessions ending t-1, 0, 2) is UNDEFINED at the first 252 scored sessions - the arm has no traded history before S0. Measured: 12 of fold-1's 29 ticks (2018-04-04 through the tick before 2019-04-04) have no defined kappa_t, yet the incremental-alpha gate is evaluated per fold including fold 1. A PIT-consistent fallback (e.g., simulating the frozen rule over the 2076-session pre-S0 runway to synthesize arm history, or any other fixed rule) must be frozen BEFORE any return is observed, per the benchmark contract no_substitution rule; choosing it after seeing fold-1 alpha would violate the contract.

C2 (freeze treatment): the early fold-1 stretch 2018-04-04..2018-11-30 (9 ticks) runs 4L/3S with net +0.25 because fixed rank thresholds 8-11 leave one empty short slot in a 10-name pool; freeze ex ante that this is accepted as an availability consequence (it will appear in the kappa regression and fold-1 net exposure).

C3 (minor, freeze byte-exactly): 'every 21st SPY session' + per-fold re-seed admits two anchorings (fold-relative vs S0-anchored) with identical counts 29/29/29 but different tick dates; the V4-I lane must pin one reading (fold-relative is the natural reading of the re-seed clause).
per_hypothesis.verdict_rationale: All floors, coverage, cap and turnover checks pass with margin; the only blocking-class item is the undefined kappa_t at S0 start, which is freezable ex ante without redesign, hence conditions rather than infeasible.

blocking_conditions: C1 (adjudicate before any scored computation): reconcile the declared ZERO SPY-context risk-match with the +/-0.25 hedge truncation. per_hypothesis.verdict_rationale: Everything implementable today; the one substantive item is the zero-multiple-vs-truncated-hedge semantics of the alpha gate, which is an A1-frozen adjudication, not a redesign.
